programme.title: Floor's rules / De regels van Floor
programme.desc: Kees breaks up with Lola, but they decide to remain friends. When Kees comes home with Fleur, Lola turns out to be at their house. Floor had a nice meeting with her. Kees is furious and gives Floor a taste of his own medicine. / Kees maakt het uit met Lola, maar ze besluiten om vrienden te blijven. Wanneer Kees thuiskomt met Fleur, blijkt Lola bij hen thuis te zijn. Floor heeft gezellig met haar afgesproken. Kees is ziedend en geeft Floor een koekje van eigen deeg.

programme.title: Floor's rules / De regels van Floor
programme.desc: Margreet and Floor go to the goat farm with school. Margreet apparently has an animal aura, so all animals always come to her. Much to Floor's annoyance, because she also wants to cuddle the goats. So she does everything she can to get an animal aura too. But whether that is so smart... / Margreet en Floor gaan met school naar de geitenboerderij. Margreet heeft blijkbaar een dierenaura, dus alle dieren komen altijd naar haar toe. Tot ergernis van Floor, want zij wil ook knuffelen met de geitjes. Dus doet ze er alles aan om ook een dierenaura te krijgen. Maar of dat nu zo slim is ...

programme.title: In other words / Met andere woorden
programme.desc: Sarah and Thomas are not happy with their colleagues from the news and the weather forecast. / Sarah en Thomas zijn niet te spreken over hun collegas van het nieuws en het weerbericht.

programme.title: The Council of Soekie / De Raad van Soekie
programme.desc: Rudyard joins the school basketball team to be popular. One problem: he can't play basketball. Their first game is against the strongest basketball team in the league. They have 48 hours to improve their basketball skills. / Rudyard wordt lid van het schoolbasketbalteam om populair te zijn. Een probleem: hij kan niet basketten. Hun eerste wedstrijd is meteen tegen het sterkste basketbalteam van de competitie. Ze hebben 48 uur om hun basketskills op te krikken.

programme.title: Bernie / Bernie
programme.desc: Funny animated series about the genius inventor Bernie who is lost at the bottom of the ocean. With his clumsy and crazy new neighbors, a return to the island will not be easy! / Grappige animatiereeks over de geniale uitvinder Bernie die verdwaald is op de bodem van de oceaan. Met zijn onhandige en maffe nieuwe buren wordt een terugkeer naar het eiland alvast niet makkelijk!

programme.title: The Hoppers / De Hoppers
programme.desc: Daria performs a 5-hour monologue about her idol: Marie Curie. But it doesn't go as she had hoped. Arno thinks that Marie Curie invented the curry sauce. And Mo wants to win a Nobel Prize. / Daria voert een 5-uur durende monoloog op over haar idool: Marie Curie. Maar die gaat niet zoals ze had verhoopt. Arno denkt dat Marie Curie de currysaus heeft uitgevonden. En Mo wil een Nobelprijs winnen.

programme.title: The Athena / The Athena
programme.desc: Nyela Malik has a big wish: to design her own clothing line. And to realize that wish, there is no better place than The Athena, a leading art school in London. / Nyela Malik heeft een grote wens: het ontwerpen van een eigen kledinglijn. En om die wens te realiseren is er geen betere plek denkbaar dan The Athena, een vooraanstaande kunstacademie in Londen.

programme.title: 3Hz / 3Hz
programme.desc: Thomas confronts Patricia. Ella, Sammy and Noor devise a plan to put even more pressure on her so they can save Felix. / Thomas gaat de confrontatie aan met Patricia. Ella, Sammy en Noor bedenken een plan om haar nog verder onder druk te zetten, zodat ze Felix kunnen redden.

programme.title: Campus 12: compilation / Campus 12: compilatie
programme.desc: When Bo is no longer himself after an attack by the Rosicrucians, Noah, Sam and Louise join forces to destroy the Stones of Wisdom. It's the only way to checkmate their dark opponents forever and give Bo her life back. To destroy the Stones they need a special device: the Crivelli. In their quest they get a new strong ally at their side. The four do everything they can to defeat the Rosicrucians... / Wanneer Bo na een aanval van de Rozenkruisers zichzelf niet meer is, slaan Noah, Sam en Louise de handen in elkaar om de Stenen der Wijsheid te vernietigen. Het is de enige manier om hun duistere tegenstanders voor altijd schaakmat te zetten en Bo haar leven terug te geven. Om de Stenen te vernietigen hebben ze een speciaal apparaat nodig: de Crivelli. In hun queeste krijgen ze een nieuwe straffe bondgenoot aan hun zij. De vier zetten alles op alles om de Rozenkruisers te verslaan...

programme.title: Worship services / Erediensten
programme.desc: The Eucharist celebration comes from the St. Remigius Church in Haacht. The theme of the celebration is: Missionaries of Hope among the people. The pastor is Pastor Theogène Havugimana and Deacon Jean Paul Pinxten. The organist is Ann Remerie. The Kantadylia choir led by Peter De Waele provides the singing. / De eucharistieviering komt vanuit de Sint-Remigiuskerk in Haacht. Het thema van de viering is: Missionarissen van Hoop tussen de mensen".Voorganger is pastoor Theogène Havugimana en diaken Jean Paul Pinxten. Organist is Ann Remerie. Het koor Kantadylia onder leiding van Peter De Waele verzorgt de zang.

programme.title: Atelier Cuvelier / Atelier Cuvelier
programme.desc: Art touches. You probably already know that. But how do artists do that? Michèle Cuvelier wants to unravel the secret of their creation. That's why she opens a studio. That is the place where art is created. Every week she invites an artist to delve deep into their creative process. How do they create? What inspires? What blocks? In short: how does their brain crackle? With unadulterated curiosity, Michèle dismantles makers, craftsmanship and magic. Welcome to the minds of great artists. Welcome to Atelier Cuvelier. / Kunst raakt. Dat weet je allicht al. Maar hoe flikken kunstenaars dat? Michèle Cuvelier wil het geheim van hun schepping ontrafelen. Daarom opent ze een atelier. Dat is de plek waar kunst ontstaat. Elke week nodigt ze een kunstenaar uit om te deep diven in hun maakproces. Hoe creëren ze? Wat inspireert? Wat blokkeert? Kortom: hoe knettert hun brein? Met onversneden nieuwsgierigheid ontmantelt Michèle makers, metier en magie. Welkom in het hoofd van straffe kunstenaars. Welkom in Atelier Cuvelier.

programme.title: Traveling Waes: the bucket list / Reizen Waes: de bucketlist
programme.desc: Tom travels through ex-Yugoslavia, a country that obviously no longer exists. The former Yugoslavia fell apart completely in the 1990s. Today it is an interesting part of Europe that Tom has never traveled through before. In the first part of the journey, Tom starts in Croatia, driving from Bosnia and Herzegovina to the Serbian capital Belgrade. Waes learns how to bobsled in an abandoned Olympic park, tastes a very special local dish and visits a remarkable pilgrimage site. An exotic journey barely 2,000 kilometers from Brussels. / Tom reist door ex-Joegoslavië, een land dat uiteraard niet meer bestaat. Ex-Joegoslavië viel in de jaren 90 volledig uit elkaar. Vandaag vormt het een interessant stukje Europa waar Tom nog nooit doorheen reisde. In het eerste deel van reis start Tom in Kroatië, om van Bosnië and Herzegovina tot in de Servische hoofdstad Belgrado te rijden. Waes leert er ondermeer bobsleeën in een verlaten Olympisch park, proeft een wel heel bijzonder lokaal gerecht en bezoekt een opmerkelijk bedevaartsoord. Een exotische reis op amper 2,000 kilometer van Brussel.

programme.title: Chantal / Chantal
programme.desc: Now that the blackmailer has been identified, a major campaign is being launched to snare him. A major responsibility for Chantal, who wants to prove with this operation that she can handle these types of situations just as well or perhaps even better than DHaese and Co. When the operation fails miserably and the blackmailer is found dead, Chantal's confidence takes a major blow. She failed. DHaese and Pit take over, although the tension between the two gentlemen is high because of Sylvie, and Chantal is licking her wounds. However, Chantal would not be Chantal if she left it at that. If the alleged blackmailer is dead and a new ransom note was sent after his death, who is the real blackmailer? / Nu de afperser gekend is, wordt een grote actie opgezet om hem te strikken. Een grote verantwoordelijkheid voor Chantal die met deze operatie wil bewijzen dat ze dit soort situaties evengoed of misschien zelfs beter aankan dan DHaese en Co. Als de operatie grandioos mislukt en de afperser daarenboven dood teruggevonden wordt, krijgt Chantals vertrouwen een fameuze knauw. Ze heeft gefaald. DHaese en Pit nemen over, al loopt de spanning tussen beide heren hoog op omwille van Sylvie, en Chantal likt haar wonden. Chantal zou echter Chantal niet zijn als ze het hierbij zou laten. Als de zogezegde afperser dood is en na zijn dood nog een nieuwe losgeldbrief opgestuurd werd, wie is dan de echte afperser?

programme.desc: During an election debate, Tess asks what Soekie is going to do about the troll living at school. Everyone laughs at Tess. If she cannot provide that, it means she is lying and he demands her dismissal. / Tijdens een verkiezingsdebat vraagt Tess wat Soekie gaat doen aan de trol die op school leeft. Iedereen lacht Tess uit. Soekie vindt het erg voor haar vriendin en liegt dat er wel degelijk een trol op school woont. Pedro wil hard bewijs van Soekie. Indien ze dat niet kan leveren, wil dat zeggen dat ze liegt en eist hij haar ontslag.

programme.title: Animal doctors 24/7 / Dierendokters 24/7
programme.desc: Sheepdog Wolf goes under the knife. The tumor in his tongue is malignant and must be removed. A mare is brought into the reproduction and obstetrics department that no longer becomes pregnant after an abortion. When examining the uterus, the specialists find the surprising cause. Student Lies has a big heart for goats. She bottle-feeds the surplus kids from the goat dairy. This also applies to billy billy. But now that he should start eating solid food like the others, he runs into problems. / Herdershond Wolf gaat onder het mes. De tumor in zijn tong is kwaadaardig en moet eruit. In de afdeling voortplanting en verloskunde wordt een merrie binnengebracht die na een abortus niet meer zwanger raakt. Bij een onderzoek van de baarmoeder vinden de specialisten de verrassende oorzaak. Student Lies heeft een groot hart voor bokjes. Ze brengt de overtollige bokjes van de geitenmelkerij groot met de fles. Zo ook bokje Billie. Maar nu hij net als de anderen vast voedsel zou moeten beginnen eten, komt hij in de problemen.

programme.title: Cops Maastricht / Flikken Maastricht

programme.title: From morning until tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the cameras of the favorite TV couple, Srna and Marko. Apart from being a couple in the studio, the two have been a couple for years in their private life as well. However, what the audience doesn't even suspect is that their on-screen idyll has nothing to do with the one when the cameras go off - the two are actually living a nightmare. When Marko asks the director of the television to resign, in order to switch to a competing television, he receives a blow that puts him in a coma, and the director finds a doppelganger, the young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play Marko for the Oscar, and will he succeed? Apart from the fact that their relationship with colleagues and friends, even rivals, will be complicated in an interesting way, with a lot of laughter and life situations, through the whirlwind of the busy life of the media, many secrets, both business and private, will be revealed, and some new loves and friendships will be born, and new avalanches of rivalries will start. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: Persona / Persona
programme.desc: The series Persona is a Turkish crime drama from 2018 directed by Onur Sajlak, which magnificently combines true tragedy and the absurdity of life, and puts moral values ​​to the test of existence. The story follows Aga, a retired judge and widower, who has been diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease. Aware that he will soon forget everything, that nothing will remain of his personality and values, he makes a fatal decision - he will kill all the criminals who skilfully escaped from under the law. He embarks on a revenge campaign, and the task of finding out who in turn twists Istanbul's dirtiest souls and minds will fall to Inspector Nevra, who has been the jailer of her own life's storms for years. Will Aga and Nerva be opponents or will they join forces? How terrible will the network of secrets be, with the death of witnesses and oblivion? / Serija Persona je turska kriminalistička drama iz 2018. godine u režiji Onura Sajlaka, koja na veličanstven način spaja istinsku tragediju i apsurd života, a na test postojanja stavlja moralne vrijednosti. Priča prati penzionisanog sudiju i udovca Agu, kojem je dijagnostifikovana Alchajmerova bolest. Svjestan da će uskoro zaboraviti sve, da od njegove ličnosti i vrijednosti neće ostati ništa, donosi kobnu odluku – ubiće sve zločince koji su se vješto izvukli ispod ruke zakona. On polazi u osvetnički pohod, a zadatak da otkrije ko redom uvija najprljavije duše i umove Istambula pripašće inspektorki Nevri, koja je već godinama tamničar sopstvenih životnih bura. Da li će Aga i Nerva biti protivnici ili će udružiti svoje snage? Koliko će strašna biti mreža tajni, smrtim svjedoka i zaborava?

programme.title: The nation bears witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-reportage show by journalist Biljana Stokić, will reveal to you what the heart of the people says about Srpska, about the tradition and history of our towns and villages, about their everyday life and the struggle to preserve true values, hard work, faith, and love for their and our homeland. In a mix of honest stories of those who live from their work, through the discovery of landmarks and natural beauties of our country and their homes, with words of hope and inspiration, and with images that melt the heart, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokić, with many years of journalistic experience, will peek into their everyday life. How does an ordinary man live? What are its problems and challenges? Where does he find the strength to work and nurture traditions and good interpersonal relationships? How does our birth lump breathe and does it have equal beauty? What do they remember? What are they amazed by? What do they return to? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell their story, those for whom we do not know how much love, perseverance, courage they carry, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt both suffering and the beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? Čega se sjećaju? Pred čim ostaju zadivljeni? Čemu se vraćaju? Pred našom kamerom, otvoriće se i ispričati priču, oni za koje ne znamo koliko u sebi nose ljubavi, istrajnosti, hrabrosti, oni koji znaju koliko je život čudnovato težak i lak, oni koji su osjetili i stradanje i ljepotu životne jednostavnosti.

programme.title: Club energy / Energo klub
programme.desc: Our new Energo Club format will provide you with relevant current events in the field of electricity production, as well as the possibility of creating renewable sources and their sustainability. We bring the words of experts and the experiences of investors, we talk about system development, trends and successful projects, we inform about the most important events dedicated to energy. / Naš novi format Energo klub pružiće vam relevantne aktuelnosti iz oblasti proizvodnje električne energije, te mogućnosti stvaranja obnovljivih izvora i njihove održivosti. Donosimo riječi stručnjaka i iskustva investitora, pričamo o razvoju sistema, trendovima i uspješnim projektima, informišemo o najvažnijim događajima posvećenim energetici.

programme.title: Blood flowers / Krvavo cvijeće
programme.desc: The story of Dilan and Baran, two young people who are forced to enter the port of marriage. Despite numerous conflicts, their unwanted marriage gives birth to a strong love. / Priča o Dilan i Baranu, dvoje mladih ljudi koji su prisiljeni uploviti u bračnu luku. Unatoč brojnim sukobima, njihov neželjeni brak iznjedriće snažnu ljubav.

programme.title: From morning until tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the cameras of the favorite TV couple, Srna and Marko. Apart from being a couple in the studio, the two have been a couple for years in their private life as well. However, what the audience doesn't even suspect is that their on-screen idyll has nothing to do with the one when the cameras go off - the two are actually living a nightmare. When Marko asks the director of the television to resign, in order to switch to a competing television, he receives a blow that puts him in a coma, and the director finds a doppelganger, the young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play Marko for the Oscar, and will he succeed? Apart from the fact that their relationship with colleagues and friends, even rivals, will be complicated in an interesting way, with a lot of laughter and life situations, through the whirlwind of the busy life of the media, many secrets, both business and private, will be revealed, and some new loves and friendships will be born, and new avalanches of rivalries will start. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: Aloa face the forehead / Alo alo
programme.desc: One of the most popular British comedies of the 80s, set in World War II France occupied by German troops. In the small town of Nouvion, Rene runs the Artois cafe, a place for the French and Germans to hang out. Colonel Von Strohm asks Rene to hide a stolen painting in his cafe, which Hitler himself wanted at the same time. Rene tries to balance his work in order to please the French Resistance and Nazi troops in order to survive. / Jedna od najpopularnijih britanskih komedija 80-ih godina, smještena u Drugi svjetski rat u Francuskoj koju su okupirale njemačke trupe. U gradiću Nouvion, Rene vodi kafić Artois, mjesto za druženje Francuza, a i Nijemaca. Pukovnik Von Strohm traži od Renea da sakrije u svom kafiću ukradenu sliku, koju je istodobno poželio i sam Hitler. Rene pokušava održati ravnotežu u svom poslu kako bi udovoljio francuskom Otporu i nacističkim trupama i tako mogao preživjeti.

programme.title: On the edge of the field / Na ivici terena
programme.desc: The show "On the edge of the field" will reveal how our famous athletes live, far from their homeland, and how they defend the colors of the biggest clubs. What does their life look like in training and on the field where they leave heart, tears and sweat and how do they spend their free time when they are not winning points and titles. Our sports enthusiasts will prepare short postcards of the cities for you, and tell you something about the history of the clubs where our athletes win not only points in important competitions and derbies, but also the hearts of the fans. You will meet some of the famous Serbian athletes who have already made their mark in the history of major European clubs. / Emisija "Na ivici terena" otkriće vam kako žive naši poznati sportisti, daleko od domovine, i kako brane boje najvećih klubova. Kako to izgleda njihov život na treninzima i na terenu na kojem se ostavlja srce, suze i znoj i kako provode slobodno vrijeme kada ne osvajaju poene i titule. Naši zaljubljenici u sport prirediće vam i kratke razglednice gradova, te vam otkriti ponešto o istoriji klubova u kojima naši sportisti vrtoglavo osvajaju ne samo bodove na važnim takmičenjima i derbijima, nego i srca navijača. Upoznaćete neke od slavnih srpskih sportista koji su se već upisali u istoriju velikih evropskih klubova.

programme.title: Cyrillic / Ćirilica
programme.desc: Popular television show by author and host Milomir Marić every Monday on ATV _ u! You will have the opportunity to watch everything that is not published even by scandalous tabloids. "Cirilica" brings the hidden background of events that are talked about the most and least known about! Milomir Marić brings together the incompatible, at the border where political propaganda and false promises stop, and reality begins. Politicians speak like ordinary people, without censorship and political platitudes. / Popularna televizijska emisija autora i voditelja Milomira Marića svakog ponedjeljka na ATV _ u! Imaćete priliku gledati sve ono što ne objavljuju čak ni skandalozni tabloidi. "Ćirilica" donosi skrivenu pozadinu događaja o kojima se najviše priča, a najmanje zna! Milomir Marić spaja nespojivo, na granici gdje prestaju politička propaganda i lažna obećanja, a počinje stvarnost. Političari govore kao obični ljudi, bez cenzure i političkih floskula.

programme.title: Persona / Persona
programme.desc: The series Persona is a Turkish crime drama from 2018 directed by Onur Sajlak, which magnificently combines true tragedy and the absurdity of life, and puts moral values ​​to the test of existence. The story follows Aga, a retired judge and widower, who has been diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease. Aware that he will soon forget everything, that nothing will remain of his personality and values, he makes a fatal decision - he will kill all the criminals who skilfully escaped from under the law. He embarks on a revenge campaign, and the task of finding out who in turn twists Istanbul's dirtiest souls and minds will fall to Inspector Nevra, who has been the jailer of her own life's storms for years. Will Aga and Nerva be opponents or will they join forces? How terrible will the network of secrets be, with the death of witnesses and oblivion? / Serija Persona je turska kriminalistička drama iz 2018. godine u režiji Onura Sajlaka, koja na veličanstven način spaja istinsku tragediju i apsurd života, a na test postojanja stavlja moralne vrijednosti. Priča prati penzionisanog sudiju i udovca Agu, kojem je dijagnostifikovana Alchajmerova bolest. Svjestan da će uskoro zaboraviti sve, da od njegove ličnosti i vrijednosti neće ostati ništa, donosi kobnu odluku – ubiće sve zločince koji su se vješto izvukli ispod ruke zakona. On polazi u osvetnički pohod, a zadatak da otkrije ko redom uvija najprljavije duše i umove Istambula pripašće inspektorki Nevri, koja je već godinama tamničar sopstvenih životnih bura. Da li će Aga i Nerva biti protivnici ili će udružiti svoje snage? Koliko će strašna biti mreža tajni, smrtim svjedoka i zaborava?

programme.title: The power of one / Snaga jednog
programme.desc: World War II... As a seven-year-old, Peekay lives on a family farm in South Africa, and is cared for by a Zulu nanny. After the death of his mother, Peekay goes to college. He almost died there during a gathering of students who were supporters of Nazi Germany. He starts living with his grandfather, and after his death, he grows up with his grandfather's friend Doc, a German musician, who ends up in prison as an illegal immigrant after the war. While visiting Doc in prison, Peekay meets Geel Piet, who teaches him boxing. / Drugi svjetski rat... Peekay kao sedmogodišnjak živi na porodičnoj farmi u Južnoj Africi, a za njega se brine dadilja porijeklom iz naroda Zulu. Nakon smrti majke, Peekay odlazi na koledž. Tamo gotovo nastrada za vrijeme okupljanja studenata pristaša nacističke Njemačke. Počinje živjeti s djedom, a nakon njegove smrti, odrasta uz djedovog prijatelja Doca, njemačkog muzičara, koji poslije rata završava u zatvoru kao ilegalni migrant. Tokom posjeta Docu u zatvoru, Peekay upoznaje Geela Pieta, koji ga nauči boksu.

programme.title: A good woman / Dobra žena
programme.desc: Thanks to the gallantry of a few married men, the widow Madame Erlynne lives on a very high footing. However, under the pressure of jealous women, she is forced to leave New York. She goes to Italy, where a rich Englishman, married to the naive but extremely beautiful Meg, catches her eye. Madam Erlynne cunningly tries to break up the young married couple, but the humiliated Meg is ready to fight back and win. Roles: Scarlett Johansson, Helen Hunt, Tom Wilkinson Director: Mike Barker / Zahvaljujući galantnosti nekolicine oženjenih muškaraca, udovica madam Erlynne živi na vrlo visokoj nozi. Ipak, pod pritiskom ljubomornih žena, prisiljena je da napusti New York. Odlazi u Italiju, gde joj za oko zapne bogati Englez, oženjen naivnom, ali izuzetno lijepom Meg. Madam Erlynne prepredeno pokušava da rastavi mladi bračni par, ali ponižena Meg spremna je i uzvratiti i pobijediti.Uloge: Scarlett Johansson, Helen Hunt, Tom Wilkinson Režija: Mike Barker

programme.title: Dimension more special / Dimenzija više specijal
programme.desc: The show "Dimenzija više spezial" hosts prominent names of the cultural scene, primarily from Bosnia and Herzegovina, brings reports and broadcasts of certain cultural manifestations. / Emisija "Dimenzija više specijal" ugošćuje istaknuta imena kulturne scene, ponajprije iz Bosne i Hercegovine, donosi reportaže i prijenose određenih kulturnih manifestacija.

programme.title: Morning for everyone / Jutro za sve
programme.desc: "Jutro za sve" is a show of the BHT1 morning program that guides viewers through the most current and interesting topics of the day, with plenty of useful information, local, regional and world news from all areas, live reporters from all parts of BiH, publishing stories about BiH citizens, tourism, culture, sports and music. / "Jutro za sve" emisija je jutarnjeg programa BHT1 koja gledatelje voditi kroz najaktuelnije i najinteresantnije teme dana, uz obilje korisnih informacija, lokalnih, regionalnih i svjetskih vijesti iz svih oblasti, javljanja reportera uživo iz svih dijelova BiH, objavljujući priče o građanima BiH, turizmu, kulturi, sportu i muzici.

programme.title: Corner - Music club BHRT / Corner - Muzički klub BHRT
programme.desc: Corner - Music Club is a show in which guests sing accompanied by the band Muzičke produkcije, conceived as a series, lasting 25 minutes of fun music, with performances by some of the most famous performers, bands and DJs of the Bosnian scene. / Corner – Muzički klub je emisija u kojoj gosti pjevaju u pratnji benda Muzičke produkcije, koncipirana kao serijal, u trajanju 25 minuta zabavne muzike, sa nastupima nekih od najpoznatijih izvođača, bendova i DJ-eva bosanskohercegovačke scene.

programme.title: News / Vijesti
programme.desc: The latest information from the country and the world. Daily review of the most important political, economic, social and cultural events. / Najnovije informacije iz zemlje i svijeta. Dnevni pregled najvažnijih političkih, ekonomskih, društvenih i kulturnih događaja.

programme.title: Barimba / Barimba
programme.desc: Barimba visits Ida and Kiki every night. Telling them various stories, this experienced sailor will teach them many things. / Barimba svaku noć posjećuje Idu i Kikija. Pričajući im razne priče, ovaj iskusni moreplovac, naučiće ih mnogo čemu.

programme.title: My pet / Moj ljubimac
programme.desc: In the magical world that surrounds us, travel with us to the very heart of nature, where our furry friends dance in the meadows, and the petals smell like old fairy tales. In this show, we discover the mysterious language of plants, the embrace of pets, and the whisper of the wind among the branches. Join us in this magic of nature.. / U čarobnom svijetu koji nas okružuje putujte sa nama u samo srce prirode, tamo gdje naši krzneni drugari plešu po livadama, a latice mirišu poput davnih priča iz bajki. U ovoj emisiji otkrivamo tajanstveni jezik biljaka, zagrljaj ljubimaca, i šapat vjetra među granama. Pridružite nam se u ovoj čaroliji prirode..

programme.title: Perspective / Perspektiva
programme.desc: "Perspektiva" is a TV series that deals with young people and their problems. It is filmed in Bosnia and Herzegovina, Serbia, Montenegro, Croatia, Kosovo and Macedonia, and broadcast on more than 30 TV stations in the region. In cooperation with Radio Free Europe, The National Endowment for Democracy (NED), Association "Education Builds BiH", the producer is Mebius Film. The first episode was released in February 2015. / "Perspektiva" je TV serijal koji se bavi mladima i njihovim problemima. Snima se u Bosni i Hercegovini, Srbiji, Crnoj Gori, Hrvatskoj, Kosovu i Makedoniji, a emituje na više od 30 TV stanica u regionu. U saradnji sa Radio Slobodna Evropa, The National Endowment for Democracy (NED), Udruženjem "Obrazovanje gradi BiH", producent je Mebius Film. Prva epizoda je objavljena u februaru 2015. godine.

programme.title: Thinking Box / Thinking Box
programme.desc: Engage your brain with Thinking Box! This show, designed for young people, encourages thinking outside the box of everyday life. It places a special focus on the promotion of young artists and talented girls and boys from all over Bosnia and Herzegovina. / Uključi mozak uz Thinking Box! Ova emisija, osmišljena za mlade, potiče razmišljanje izvan okvira svakodnevice. Poseban fokus stavlja na promociju mladih umjetnika i talentovanih djevojaka i mladića iz svih krajeva Bosne i Hercegovine.

programme.title: News / Vijesti
programme.desc: The latest information from the country and the world. Daily review of the most important political, economic, social and cultural events. / Najnovije informacije iz zemlje i svijeta. Dnevni pregled najvažnijih političkih, ekonomskih, društvenih i kulturnih događaja.

programme.title: Agro-Ekologika / Agro-Ekologika
programme.desc: Broadcast about nature, environment and sustainable development in Bosnia and Herzegovina. It brings stories from the field, conversations with experts and a presentation of environmental and agricultural projects that are changing local communities. / Emisija o prirodi, okolišu i održivom razvoju u BiH. Donosi priče s terena, razgovore sa stručnjacima i prikaz ekoloških i poljoprivrednih projekata koji mijenjaju lokalne zajednice.

programme.title: Shift / Shift
programme.desc: An educational show that deals with the impact of the Internet, digital devices and modern technology on people and their lives. Each edition of the show focuses on a specific topic, which it covers thoroughly. The goal is to educate users about digital platforms and social networks and conscientious consumption of content on the Internet. / Edukativna emisija koja se bavi uticajem interneta, digitalnih uređaja i moderne tehnologije na ljude i njihove živote. Svako izdanje emisije u fokus stavlja određenu temu koju temeljito obrađuje. Cilj je obrazovati korisnike o digitalnim platformama i društvenim mrežama te savjesnom konzumiranju sadržaja na internetu.

programme.title: My country / Moja zemlja
programme.desc: A show dedicated to Bosnia and Herzegovina and us in it, people, lives, destinies, what people live, what they would like to fix, show or preserve for some new generations. The earth is not (only) space, it is not only mountains, rivers, valleys, the earth is, above all, people. The country is not made up of flags, political pamphlets, the country is made up of ordinary people with everyday lives, joys and sorrows... About such and such a country is the new series of the BHT1 informative program, "My Country", edited and driven by Elvir Bucalo, driving his oldtimer around the wonderful Bosnia and Herzegovina. / Emisija posvećena Bosni i Hercegovini i nama u njoj, ljudima, životima, sudbinama, onome što ljudi žive, što bi htjeli popraviti, ukazati ili sačuvati za neke nove generacije. Zemlja nije (samo) prostor, nisu samo planine, rijeke, doline, zemlja su, prije svega, ljudi. Zemlju ne čine zastave, politički pamfleti, zemlju čine obični ljudi sa svakodnevnim životima, radostima i tugama... O toj i takvoj zemlji govori novi serijal Informativnog programa BHT1, "Moja zemlja", koji uređuje i, vozeći svoj oldtimer obilazi s kraja na kraj čudesne Bosne i Hercegovine, vodi Elvir Bucalo.

programme.title: News / Vijesti
programme.desc: The latest information from the country and the world. Daily review of the most important political, economic, social and cultural events. / Najnovije informacije iz zemlje i svijeta. Dnevni pregled najvažnijih političkih, ekonomskih, društvenih i kulturnih događaja.

programme.title: Ways of health / Putevi zdravlja
programme.desc: In the show, we talk about the 10th Congress of BiH Cardiologists, the lack of a registry of cardiovascular diseases and why it must be created, heart failure and its treatment, and the relationship between mental and cardiovascular diseases. With 20.10. On World Osteoporosis Day, we give instructions on prevention. The series is edited and hosted by Olivera Dodig. / U emisiji govorimo o 10. Kongresu kardiologa BiH, o nepostojanju registra kardiovaskularnih bolesti i zašto se mora napraviti, o srčanoj slabosti i tretiranju, te odnosu mentalne i kardiovaskularnih bolesti. Uz 20.10. Svjetski dan osteoporoze dajemo naputak o prevenciji. Serijal uređuje i vodi Olivera Dodig.

programme.title: Fundus / Fundus
programme.desc: "Fundus" is a format of TV stories whose themes are Bosnia and Herzegovina. cultural and historical heritage, unknown stories and details from our heritage, but also a reminder of the valuable cultural treasures kept by museums throughout the country. The best promotion of the country is through its rich and varied culture. Museum depots store thousands of valuable objects and exhibits, among which are numerous world rarities. Collections are in no way behind the settings in prestigious European and world museums. With this form, BHRT wants to present them to the general public and remind them of their value. The stories cover only the basic and most interesting details, with the aim of encouraging viewers to visit the museums and institutions where the exhibits are located for more information. In Fundus, you will see interesting things that you did not know until now, objects that you have not seen before, and it will also present a part of the tradition about which there is no recorded information. / "Fundus" je format TV priča čije su teme bh. kulturno-historijsko naslijeđe, nepoznate priče i detalji iz naše baštine, ali i podsjećanje na vrijedno kulturno blago koje čuvaju muzeji širom zemlje. Najbolja promocija države je preko njene bogate i raznovrsne kulture. Muzejski depoi čuvaju hiljade vrijednih predmeta i eksponata, među kojima su brojni svjetski rariteti. Kolekcije i zbirke ni po čemu ne zaostaju za postavkama u uglednim evropskim i svjetskim muzejima. Ovom formom BHRT želi da ih predstavi široj javnosti i podsjeti na njihovu vrijednost. Priče obrađuju samo osnovne i najzanimljivije detalje, s ciljem da potaknu gledatelje da za više informacija posjete muzeje i ustanove u kojima se nalaze eksponati. U Fundusu ćete vidjeti zanimljivosti koje do sada niste znali, predmete koje niste prije vidjeli, a predstaviće i dio tradicije o kojoj nema zabilježenih informacija.

programme.title: A look into the future / Pogled u budućnost
programme.desc: An international TV show that brings us interesting reports and documentaries on various topics. / Međunarodna TV emisija koja nam donosi zanimljive reportaže i dokumentarne filmove o različitim temama.

programme.title: In Medias Res / In Medias Res
programme.desc: The month of October is the month of missionary solidarity in the Catholic Church, and this month's editions of the show are dedicated to individuals who have dedicated their lives to missionary work and service to others. Brother Ivica Vrbić, a native of Zavidov, has been tirelessly and devotedly serving in Bolivia for a decade, where he is one of the most prominent employees of the "Minero" mission. In a conversation with Haris E. Bilalović, Fr. Ivica talks about his mission in Bolivia, the challenges he faces every day, but also about the witty ways in which he successfully overcomes these same challenges with the help of God's grace and providence. / Mjesec oktobar je mjesec misionarske solidarnosti u Katoličkoj crkvi te su ovomjesečna izdanja emisije posvećena pojedincima koji su svoje živote posvetili misionarstvu i služenju drugima. Fra Ivica Vrbić, rođeni Zavidovčanin, već deceniju neumorno i predano služi u Boliviji gdje je jedan od najistaknutijih djelatnika misije "Minero". U razgovoru sa Harisom E. Bilalovićem, fra Ivica govori o svojoj misiji u Boliviji, izazovima sa kojima se svakodnevno suočava, ali i o dovitljivim načinima na koje te iste izazova uz pomoć Božije milosti i providnosti uspješno prevazilazi.

programme.title: Consolation prize / Utešna nagrada
programme.desc: Growing up in a dysfunctional family and children's homes, the troubled boy James never felt real parental love. From his earliest childhood, he was often a witness to his parents' quarrels, and his rebellious father John kidnapped him from home several times and lived with him in inhumane conditions deep in the forest. All this left a deep psychological impact on James, which caused his inflexibility and occasional antisocial behavior. Retired Graham Holt, postmaster in a provincial town in Wales, approached Social Services with a request to adopt a child. Social worker Debbie and her colleague Bernard, after a thorough check, decide to entrust him with James for a trial period. Unlike boys, Graham grew up in the love of possessive parents, who made him an emotionally insecure person. Difficulty establishing relationships with the opposite sex, Graham took care of his seriously ill father Edward after his mother's death. He likes the sensitive James, because of his uncontrolled outbursts... However, because of his tendency to self-harm, Graham concludes that it will be difficult to establish an intimate relationship with him. / Odrastajući u disfunkcionalnoj porodici i dječjim domovima, problematični dječak James nikada nije osjetio pravu roditeljsku ljubav. Još od najranijeg djetinjstva često je bio svjedok svađama svojih roditelja, a buntovni ga je otac John nekoliko puta oteo iz doma i s njim u neljudskim uvjetima živio duboko u šumi. Sve je to na Jamesa ostavilo duboke psihičke posljedice, koje su uzrokovale njegovu neprilagodljivost i povremeno asocijalno ponašanje. Povučeni Graham Holt, šef pošte u provincijskom gradiću u Walesu, javi se Socijalnoj službi s molbom za usvajanje djeteta. Socijalna radnica Debbie i njen kolega Bernard mu nakon temeljite provjere na probni rok odluče povjeriti upravo Jamesa. Za razliku od dječaka, Graham je odrastao u ljubavi posesivnih roditelja, koji su od njega stvorili emotivno nesigurnu osobu. Teško uspostavljajući odnose sa suprotnim spolom, Graham je nakon majčine smrti preuzeo brigu o teško bolesnom ocu Edwardu. Senzibilni James mu se svidi, zbog njegovih nekontroliranih ispada... Ipak zbog sklonosti samoozljeđivanju Graham zaključi da će s njim teško uspostaviti prisan odnos.

programme.title: New adventure / Nova avantura
programme.desc: The story of Noble Miss Irby, the mother of the poor, thanks to whom generations of future intellectuals of that time were educated... Her school was known as "Miss Irby's Institute" or "The Women's Institute of Noble Miss Irby in Sarajevo". Later, this school will grow into a secondary teacher's school. In the years that followed, the girls who attended the Institute had the opportunity to continue their education throughout Europe... Ivo Andrić, Aleksa Šantić and many others wrote about her, and excerpts from her book were once quoted in the British Parliament... Editor: Nihada Alajbegović / Priča o Plemenitoj Miss Irby, majci sirotinje, zahvaljujući kojoj su školovane generacije budućih intelektualki tog vremena... Njena škola je bila poznata pod nazivom "Mis Irbijev zavod" ili "Ženski institut plemenite Mis Irbijeve u Sarajevu". Kasnije će ova škola prerasti u Srednju učiteljsku školu. U godinama koje su slijedile, djevojčice koje su pohađale Zavod imale su priliku nastaviti svoje školovanje širom Europe... O njoj su pisali Ivo Andrić, Aleksa Šantić i mnogi drugi, a izvode iz njene knjige citirali su svojevremeno i u britanskom parlamentu... Urednica: Nihada Alajbegović

programme.title: Slow down! / Smanji gas!
programme.desc: Educational series "Smanji gas!" it is intended for drivers, who in this way want to focus their attention on behavior and culture in traffic. / Edukativni serijal "Smanji gas!" namijenjen je vozačima, kojima se na ovaj način želi usmjeriti pažnja na ponašanje i kulturu u saobraćaju.

programme.desc: Diary 2 / Dnevnik 2

programme.title: Weather forecast and road conditions / Vremenska prognoza i stanje na putevima
programme.desc: The latest weather forecast for Bosnia and Herzegovina and the region, with information on road conditions. / Najnovija vremenska prognoza za Bosnu i Hercegovinu i regiju, uz informacije o stanju na putevima.

programme.title: Once upon a time... / Bilo jednom...
programme.desc: We present the documentary film "Once upon a time..." which tells about the war years in Bosnia and Herzegovina. / Donosimo dokumentarni film "Bilo jednom..." koji govori o ratnim godinama u Bosni i Hercegovini.

programme.title: Mostar Blues and Rock Festival / Mostar Blues and Rock Festival
programme.desc: This year's edition of the Mostar Blues And Rock Festival brought top performances by local and foreign artists, but also a recognizable atmosphere that has made Mostar one of the most important musical centers of the region for years. We recorded for you the energy of the festival, conversations with musicians and organizers, along with authentic scenes from concerts that confirm that Mostar still plays its recognizable rhythm - the rhythm of freedom, togetherness and music that connects. / Ovogodišnje izdanje Mostar Blues And Rock festivala donijelo je vrhunske nastupe domaćih i stranih izvođača, ali i prepoznatljivu atmosferu koja Mostar već godinama čini jednim od najvažnijih muzičkih središta regije. Za vas smo zabilježili energiju festivala, razgovore sa muzičarima i organizatorima, uz autentične prizore s koncerata koji potvrđuju da Mostar i dalje svira svoj prepoznatljivi ritam _ ritam slobode, zajedništva i muzike koja povezuje.

programme.title: Heritage treasure / Blago naslijeđa
programme.desc: TV series about cultural and historical treasures, as well as about traditional values ​​of Bosnia and Herzegovina. A story about life in these areas... creation, beauty, history, culture, and construction. What does heritage treasure actually mean, how much attention do we pay to it, how much do we know about it? / TV serijal o kulturnom i historijskom blagu, kao i o tradicionalnim vrijednostima područja Bosne i Hercegovine. Priča o životu na ovim prostorima... stvaranju, ljepoti, historiji, kulturi, i graditeljstvu. Što blago naslijeđa zapravo znači, koliko mu pažnje posvećujemo, koliko znamo o njemu?

programme.title: Music switchboard / Muzička centrala
programme.desc: The best singers of folk and pop rock music in one place accompanied by the BHRT Music Production Orchestra. / Najbolji pjevači narodne i pop rock muzike na jednom mjestu uz pratnju Orkestra Muzičke produkcije BHRT-a.

programme.desc: Overview of current sports news from Bosnia and Herzegovina, the region and the world. / Pregled aktuelnih sportskih vijesti iz Bosne i Hercegovine, regiona i svijeta.

programme.title: A draft / Propuh
programme.desc: A show about the alternative music scene in BiH and the region, in which we present part of what is currently most interesting in the punk, metal, hardcore and noise scene, as well as in the field of all other musical genres and subgenres, under the common name alternative. The show is, above all, inspired by the expansion of alternative music in BiH in recent years, as well as new spaces, real and virtual, where alternative culture takes place. / Emisija o alternativnoj muzičkoj sceni u BiH i regionu, u kojoj predstavljamo dio onoga što je trenutno najzanimljivije na punk, metal, hardcore i noise sceni, kao i u oblasti svih drugih muzičkih žanrova i podžanrova, pod zajedničkim nazivom alternativna. Emisija je, prije svega, inspirisana ekspanzijom alternativne muzike u BiH posljednjih godina, kao i novim prostorima, stvarnim i virtualnim, u kojima se alternativna kultura dešava.

programme.title: Dimension more special / Dimenzija više specijal
programme.desc: The show "Dimenzija više spezial" hosts prominent names of the cultural scene, primarily from Bosnia and Herzegovina, brings reports and broadcasts of certain cultural manifestations. / Emisija "Dimenzija više specijal" ugošćuje istaknuta imena kulturne scene, ponajprije iz Bosne i Hercegovine, donosi reportaže i prijenose određenih kulturnih manifestacija.

programme.title: The power of one / Snaga jednog
programme.desc: World War II... As a seven-year-old, Peekay lives on a family farm in South Africa, and is cared for by a Zulu nanny. After the death of his mother, Peekay goes to college. He almost died there during a gathering of students who were supporters of Nazi Germany. He starts living with his grandfather, and after his death, he grows up with his grandfather's friend Doc, a German musician, who ends up in prison as an illegal immigrant after the war. While visiting Doc in prison, Peekay meets Geel Piet, who teaches him boxing. / Drugi svjetski rat... Peekay kao sedmogodišnjak živi na porodičnoj farmi u Južnoj Africi, a za njega se brine dadilja porijeklom iz naroda Zulu. Nakon smrti majke, Peekay odlazi na koledž. Tamo gotovo nastrada za vrijeme okupljanja studenata pristaša nacističke Njemačke. Počinje živjeti s djedom, a nakon njegove smrti, odrasta uz djedovog prijatelja Doca, njemačkog muzičara, koji poslije rata završava u zatvoru kao ilegalni migrant. Tokom posjeta Docu u zatvoru, Peekay upoznaje Geela Pieta, koji ga nauči boksu.

programme.title: Morning for everyone / Jutro za sve
programme.desc: "Jutro za sve" is a show of the BHT1 morning program that guides viewers through the most current and interesting topics of the day, with plenty of useful information, local, regional and world news from all areas, live reporters from all parts of BiH, publishing stories about BiH citizens, tourism, culture, sports and music. / "Jutro za sve" emisija je jutarnjeg programa BHT1 koja gledatelje voditi kroz najaktuelnije i najinteresantnije teme dana, uz obilje korisnih informacija, lokalnih, regionalnih i svjetskih vijesti iz svih oblasti, javljanja reportera uživo iz svih dijelova BiH, objavljujući priče o građanima BiH, turizmu, kulturi, sportu i muzici.

programme.title: News / Vijesti
programme.desc: The latest information from the country and the world. Daily review of the most important political, economic, social and cultural events. / Najnovije informacije iz zemlje i svijeta. Dnevni pregled najvažnijih političkih, ekonomskih, društvenih i kulturnih događaja.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V / Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The animated series follows the exciting adventures of the daring boy Yuya Sakaki, whose father disappeared three years ago. The boy's big dream is to follow in his father's footsteps and become a top duelist. After he unexpectedly discovers a new technique for summoning monsters, that dream slowly begins to become his reality. / Animirana serija prati uzbudljive avanture odvažnog dječaka Yuye Sakakija, čiji je otac nestao prije tri godine. Dječakov veliki san je poći očevim stopama i postati vrhunski duelist. Nakon što nenadano otkrije novu tehniku za prizivanje čudovišta, taj san polako počinje biti njegova stvarnost.

programme.title: Perspective / Perspektiva
programme.desc: "Perspektiva" is a TV series that deals with young people and their problems. It is filmed in Bosnia and Herzegovina, Serbia, Montenegro, Croatia, Kosovo and Macedonia, and broadcast on more than 30 TV stations in the region. In cooperation with Radio Free Europe, The National Endowment for Democracy (NED), Association "Education Builds BiH", the producer is Mebius Film. The first episode was released in February 2015. / "Perspektiva" je TV serijal koji se bavi mladima i njihovim problemima. Snima se u Bosni i Hercegovini, Srbiji, Crnoj Gori, Hrvatskoj, Kosovu i Makedoniji, a emituje na više od 30 TV stanica u regionu. U saradnji sa Radio Slobodna Evropa, The National Endowment for Democracy (NED), Udruženjem "Obrazovanje gradi BiH", producent je Mebius Film. Prva epizoda je objavljena u februaru 2015. godine.

programme.title: The speech of silence / Govor tišine
programme.desc: The speech of silence, a show for people with impaired hearing and speech. / Govor tišine, emisija za osobe sa oštećenim sluhom i govorom.

programme.title: Shift / Shift
programme.desc: An educational show that deals with the impact of the Internet, digital devices and modern technology on people and their lives. Each edition of the show focuses on a specific topic, which it covers thoroughly. The goal is to educate users about digital platforms and social networks and conscientious consumption of content on the Internet. / Edukativna emisija koja se bavi uticajem interneta, digitalnih uređaja i moderne tehnologije na ljude i njihove živote. Svako izdanje emisije u fokus stavlja određenu temu koju temeljito obrađuje. Cilj je obrazovati korisnike o digitalnim platformama i društvenim mrežama te savjesnom konzumiranju sadržaja na internetu.

programme.title: Bridges of diversity / Mostovi različitosti
programme.desc: About the position and everyday life of national minorities in Bosnia and Herzegovina, with special reference to the preservation of cultural identity, language, issues of discrimination and existing stereotypes. About successful integrations and positive practices, but also about social and political exclusion, legal solutions and their application. Through personal stories of members of different national minorities, in different parts of BiH, conversations with activists, government representatives and citizens, the film reveals the complexity of identity and the treasures that BiH has, thanks to their decision to live and work in BiH, but also detects the necessary changes. What challenges do they face, starting from education to employment, double standards, preservation of language and culture. On examples of good practice in the region and Western Europe / O položaju i svakodnevnom životu nacionalnih manjina u BiH, sa posebnim osvrtom na očuvanje kulturnog identiteta, jezika, pitanja diskriminacije i prisutnih stereotipa. O uspješnim integracijama i pozitivnim praksama, ali i o društvenoj i političkoj isključenosti, zakonskim rješenjima i njihovoj primjeni. Kroz lične priče pripadnika različitih nacionalnih manjina, u različitim dijelovima BiH, razgovore sa aktivistima, predstavnicima vlasti i građanima, film otkriva kompleksnost identiteta i blago koje BiH ima, zahvaljujući njihovoj odluci da žive i rade u BiH, ali i detektuje potrebne promjene. Sa kojim izazovima se susreću, počevši od obrazovanja do zapošljavanja, dvostrukih standarda, očuvanja jezika i kulture. O primjerima dobre prakse u regionu i zapadnoj Evropi

programme.title: American Railroad Travel / Putovanja američkom željeznicom
programme.desc: In this episode, Michael Portillo continues his exploration of the city of Chicago. He visited the largest railway junction in the country, learned how to bake brownies according to Bertha Palmer's recipe. After that, he moves south to the state of Illinois, where he attends the University of Illinois. It reveals how Frank Lloyd Wright influenced American architecture. / U ovoj epizodi Michael Portillo nastavlja sa istraživanjem grada Chicaga. Posjetio je najveće željezničko čvorište u zemlji, naučio je kako ispeći kolač brownie po receptu Berthe Palmer. Nakon toga kreće južnije državom Illinois, gdje posjećuje Univerzitet u Illinoisu. Otkriva kako je Frank Lloyd Wright utjecao na američku arhitekturu.

programme.title: BHT 1 live / BHT 1 uživo
programme.desc: The motto of the BHT 1 live show is "News plus". In the show, information, analysis, predictions and the background of the event. Experts, analysts and citizens speak live for BHT 1. Comments on what is being talked about on social networks, and analysis of the topic of the day. Part of the content of the show are reports about lesser-known places, but also stories about beautiful and unusual regions of our country, and valuable and interesting people. / Moto emisije BHT 1 uživo je "Vijest plus". U emisiji informacije, analize, predviđanja i pozadina događaja. Za BHT 1 uživo govore stručnjaci, analitičari i građani. Komentari o čemu se priča na društvenim mrežama, i analiza teme dana. Dio sadržaja emisije su i reportaže o manje poznatim mjestima, ali i priče o lijepim i neobičnim predjelima naše zemlje, te vrijednim i zanimljivim ljudima.

programme.title: Victims of love / Žrtve ljubavi
programme.desc: Count Farnesi decides to help Brando's family, which is in big trouble. Lucrezia's brother Livio did not take it well, because he considers them peasants and Brando unworthy of his sister's love. Maddalena goes to Villa Corradi to ask Silvia for an explanation. After the initial embarrassment, Mrs. Corradi speaks openly with Brando's sister and reveals to her the real reasons why she could not acquit Maddalena of the charge of theft. In addition, she asks Maddalena not to reveal to Brando how much she has sacrificed for love, because it is better that he still hates her. Count Volpi visits Leopold Corradi and condemns him for not helping Albert in his political struggles. During a heated discussion, Goffredo reveals to Leopold the shocking fact that Alessandro is the son of the venerable mother Agnes! Maddalena is convinced that Brando needs to find out the truth about Silvia and goes to Des Alpes with the intention of revealing everything to him. But there she encounters a situation that may force her to change her plan. Cast: Francesca Valtorta, Giorgio Lupano, Rocco Giusti, Desiree Nofereini, Federica De Benedittis / Grof Farnesi odlučuje pomoći Brandovoj obitelji koja je u velikim problemima. Lucrezijin brat Livio to nije dobro prihvatio, jer on ih smatra seljacima, a Branda nevrijednim ljubavi njegove sestre. Maddalena odlazi u vilu Corradi kako bi Silviju zamolila za objašnjenje. Nakon prvobitne neugode, gđa Corradi otvoreno razgovara sa Brandovom sestrom i otkriva joj stvarne razloge zašto nije mogla Maddalenu osloboditi optužbe za krađu. Osim toga, zamoli Maddalenu da ne otkrije Brandu koliko se žrtvovala za ljubav, jer je bolje da je on i dalje mrzi. Leopoldu Corradiju u posjet dolazi grof Volpi, i osuđuje ga što nije pomogao Albertu u političkim borbama. Tokom žustre rasprave, Goffredo otkriva Leopoldu šokantnu činjenicu, da je Alessandro sin časne majke Agnese! Maddalena je uvjerena da Brando treba saznati istinu o Silviji te odlazi u Des Alpes s namjerom da mu sve otkrije. No tamo zatekne situaciju koja će je možda nagnati da promijeni svoj plan. Uloge: Francesca Valtorta, Giorgio Lupano, Rocco Giusti, Desiree Nofereini, Federica De Benedittis

programme.title: Three mace / Tri mace
programme.desc: Animated series for the youngest about the adventures of three fearless kittens who are always ready for new challenges. The cheerful kitten Keksić lives with his big brother Čoka and little sister Lola. Their days are filled with fun and spending time with their best friends. They like to play, eat sweets, and explore unknown phenomena and objects that surround them. Every day they embark on a new adventure, and thanks to the wise advice of their caring parents, they overcome all obstacles and learn numerous life lessons. / Animirana serija za najmlađe o pustolovinama tri neustrašiva mačića koji su uvijek spremni za nove izazove. Veseli mačić Keksić živi s velikim bratom Čokom i malenom sestrom Lolom. Njihovi dani ispunjeni su zabavom i druženjem s najboljim prijateljima. Vole se igrati, jesti slatkiše, te istraživati nepoznate pojave i predmete koji ih okružuju. Svaki dan upuštaju se u novu pustolovinu, a zahvaljujući mudrim savjetima njihovih brižnih roditelja, rješavaju sve prepreke i uče brojne životne lekcije.

programme.title: Fundus / Fundus
programme.desc: "Fundus" is a format of TV stories whose themes are Bosnia and Herzegovina. cultural and historical heritage, unknown stories and details from our heritage, but also a reminder of the valuable cultural treasures kept by museums throughout the country. The best promotion of the country is through its rich and varied culture. Museum depots store thousands of valuable objects and exhibits, among which are numerous world rarities. Collections are in no way behind the settings in prestigious European and world museums. With this form, BHRT wants to present them to the general public and remind them of their value. The stories cover only the basic and most interesting details, with the aim of encouraging viewers to visit the museums and institutions where the exhibits are located for more information. In Fundus, you will see interesting things that you did not know until now, objects that you have not seen before, and it will also present a part of the tradition about which there is no recorded information. / "Fundus" je format TV priča čije su teme bh. kulturno-historijsko naslijeđe, nepoznate priče i detalji iz naše baštine, ali i podsjećanje na vrijedno kulturno blago koje čuvaju muzeji širom zemlje. Najbolja promocija države je preko njene bogate i raznovrsne kulture. Muzejski depoi čuvaju hiljade vrijednih predmeta i eksponata, među kojima su brojni svjetski rariteti. Kolekcije i zbirke ni po čemu ne zaostaju za postavkama u uglednim evropskim i svjetskim muzejima. Ovom formom BHRT želi da ih predstavi široj javnosti i podsjeti na njihovu vrijednost. Priče obrađuju samo osnovne i najzanimljivije detalje, s ciljem da potaknu gledatelje da za više informacija posjete muzeje i ustanove u kojima se nalaze eksponati. U Fundusu ćete vidjeti zanimljivosti koje do sada niste znali, predmete koje niste prije vidjeli, a predstaviće i dio tradicije o kojoj nema zabilježenih informacija.

programme.title: Sports Focus / Sport Fokus
programme.desc: After the matches of the BiH national football team, the sports magazine BHT1, with our expert consultant Kemal Alispahić, switches the focus back to the Wwin league and the 11th round matches. We were in Cazin with the best B&H. handball players, as well as in Živinice, where we saw off the double match of the first round of the EHF European Cup of our Konjuh. In the regular "Alphabet of Sports" column, after swimming, we stay in the pool and learn about the basics of water polo. / Nakon mečeva nogometne reprezentacije BiH, sportski magazin BHT1, sa našim stručnim konsultantom Kemalom Alispahićem, fokus prebacuje ponovo na Wwin ligu i utakmice 11. kola. Bili smo u Cazinu uz najbolje bh. rukometašice, kao i u Živinicama, gdje smo ispratili dvomeč prve runde EHF Evropa kupa našeg Konjuha. U redovnoj rubrici "Abeceda sporta" nakon plivanja ostajemo u bazenu i upoznajemo se sa osnovama vaterpola.

programme.title: INSide Market / INSide Market
programme.desc: How do employers in Bosnia and Herzegovina today balance between wage growth and employee productivity expectations? This is certainly one of the biggest challenges we face, due to the complexity of relationships and expectations of both employees and employers. Does salary growth in Bosnia and Herzegovina currently follow the real productivity of employees? What do the official indicators say, what is the current situation and what can we expect in the coming period? These questions are answered by Safudin Čengić, Chairman of the Economic and Social Council for the territory of FBiH and member of the UPFBiH, Vesna Buvarović, Director of the Human Resources Management Sector of ASA Bank, Sanda Ljukovac, Senior HR Expert Festina Lente, Dr. Emina Žunić Dželihodžić, Independent Expert Associate for Monetary Policy, Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina / Kako danas poslodavci u BiH balansiraju između rasta plata i očekivanja u produktivnosti zaposlenih? Ovo je zasigurno jedan od najvećih izazova sa kojim se susrećemo, zbog kompleksnosti odnosa i očekivanja kako uposlenika tako i poslodavaca. Da li rast plata u BiH trenutno prati realnu produktivnost zaposlenih? Šta kažu zvanični pokazatelji, kakvo je trenutno stanje i šta možemo očekivati u narednom periodu? Na ova pitanja odgovaraju Safudin Čengić, predsjedavajući Ekonomsko-socijalnog vijeća za teritoriju FBiH i član UPFBiH, Vesna Buvarović, direktorica Sektora za upravljanje ljudskim resursima ASA Banka, Sanda Ljukovac, Senior HR ekspert Festina Lente, dr Emina Žunić Dželihodžić, samostalni stručni saradnik za monetarnu politiku, Centralna Banka Bosne i Hercegovine

programme.title: A game of fate / Igra sudbine
programme.desc: Faik is recovering from a stroke, has difficulty walking and cannot speak. Sultan is a new member of the Board of Directors. Firat is released from prison. Kerem returns from Germany and starts his provocations in the company. Tahsin comes to Perihana's grave. Feride is disappointed that Aziz does not recognize her, but she decides to be patient and not give up on Aziz. Hasibe comes to Tahsin and asks him to rescue his son from prison. Emine is worried about Jalcin and is waiting for him in front of the police station. Cast: Kadir Doğulu, Devrim Özkan, Ümit Kantarcılar, Onur Seyit Yaran, Gozde Kaya, Pelin Uluksar, Mehmet Ozgur Director: Murat Onbul / Faik se oporavlja od moždanog udara, teško hoda i ne može govoriti. Sultan je novi član Upravnog odbora. Firat izlazi iz zatvora. Kerem se vraća iz Njemačke i počinje sa svojim provokacijama u firmi. Tahsin dolazi na Perihanin grob. Feride je razočarana što je Aziz ne prepoznaje, ali je odlučila biti strpljiva i ne odustati od Aziza. Hasibe dolazi kod Tahsina i traži od njega da mu izbavi sina iz zatvora. Emine je zabrinuta za Jalčina i čeka ga ispred policijske stanice. Uloge: Kadir Doğulu, Devrim Özkan, Ümit Kantarcılar, Onur Seyit Yaran, Gozde Kaya, Pelin Uluksar, Mehmet Ozgur Režija: Murat Onbul

programme.desc: This 13-episode series tells the story of King Arthur's famous wizard Merlin. Even before it became known as the place of the Knights of the Round Table, the mythical city of Camelot was home to men, beasts and mythical creatures. However, in this world, magic is banned by the tyrant Uther Pedragón. When a young man named Merlin arrives in the city, he quickly makes many enemies because of the mystical and incredible powers he possesses. Among the enemies is Uther's heir, Prince Arthur. With the help of a doctor named Gaius, Merlin will be able to start using his talents not only to survive, but also to unlock the secrets of Camelot. The first thing that Merlin will discover is that his fate is closely connected with the young Arthur. / Този сериал от 13 епизода разказва историята на именития магьосник на крал Артур Мерлин. В митичния град Камелот още преди той да стане известен като мястото на рицарите на кръглата маса, живеят хора, зверове и митични създания. В този свят обаче магията е забранена от тиранина Утър Педрагон.Когато млад мъж на име Мерлин пристига в града, той бързо си спечелва много врагове заради мистичните и невероятни сили, които притежава. Сред враговете е и наследника на Утър принц Артур. С помощта на един лекар на име Гайъс Мерлин ще успее да започне да използва талантите си не само, за да оцелява, но и за да отключи тайните на Камелот.Първото нещо, което ще открие Мерлин, че съдбата му е близко свързана с младия Артур.

programme.desc: The Spanish Basketball League was founded in 1957 as the National League and received its current format in 1983 when the ACB organization took control of the competition. According to the scoring, Liga ACB is one of the three best European leagues. There are currently 18 teams in the league that play each other twice a season. The team with the most titles won is Real Madrid, closely followed by Barcelona. The Spanish league has given us some of the world's greatest players and coaches throughout history. / Испанската баскетболна лига е основана през 1957 г. като Национална лига и получава настоящия си формат през 1983 г., когато организацията ACB поема контрола над състезанието. Според точкуването Лига ACB е една от трите най-добри европейски лиги. В момента в лигата участват 18 отбора, които играят помежду си два пъти през сезона. Отборът с най-много спечелени титли е Реал Мадрид, но плътно следван от Барселона. Испанското първенство ни даде някои от най-великите играчи и треньори в света през цялата история.

programme.desc: League 1 consists of 20 teams competing against each other in 38 rounds, on an alternating away basis. The French championship dates back to 1892, the so-called Amateur League until 1929. In 1932, the foundations of professionally organized football in France were laid. The French Division 1 included in its first season, 1932-33, the following teams, divided into two groups: Club Française, Excelsior, Hierre, Lille, Marseille, Mulhouse, Nice, Nîmes, Racing Paris, Sette, Ale, Antibes, Cannes, SA Paris, Fives, Metz, Montpellier, Red Star, Rennes and Sochaux. In recent years, the club Paris Saint-Germain, formed much later, has been an absolute dominator on the domestic scene, but before that Lyon, Marseille, Bordeaux, Monaco, Nantes, Saint-Etienne, Reims, Nice, Lance, etc. also had a lot of success. / Лига 1 се състои от 20 отбора, които се състезават един срещу друг в 38 кръга, на разменено гостуване. Френският шампионат датира от 1892, така нареченета Аматьорска лига до 1929. През 1932 се полагат основите на професионално организраният футбол във Франция. Френската Дивизия 1 включва в своя първи сезон 1932-33 следните отбори, разделени в две групи: Клуб Франсе, Екселсиор, Иер, Лил, Марсилия, Мюлуз, Ница, Ним, Расинг Париж, Сет, Але, Антиб, Кан, СА Париж, Фив, Метц, Монпелие, Ред Стар, Рен и Сошо. През последните години доста по-късно сформирания клуб Пари Сен Жермен е абсолютен доминатор на домашната сцена, но преди това много успехи са имали също Лион, Марсилия, Бордо, Монако, Нан, Сен Етиен, Рейм, Ница, Ланс и др.

programme.title: I bila je / I bila je
programme.desc: Write and Wrong - (komedija, SAD, 2007) TV film. Byrdie je plodna scenaristica na pragu pedesete. Problem je što nitko od producenata ne želi raditi s njom. Iako je upravo dovršila vjerojatno najbolji scenarij u svom životu, njezin joj agent ne uzvraća pozive, a nitko ga od filmaša ne želi pročitati. Stoga smisli plan kako da im se osveti. U želji da oživi svoju karijeru, Byrdie potraži pomoć svog šarmantnog i privlačnog dvadeset-i-nešto-godišnjeg nećaka, bivšeg prodavača rabljenih automobila, Neila. Baš poput Cyrana de Bergeraca, Byrdie piše scenarije, a Neil ih studijima nudi kao svoje. Zahvaljujući Byrdienoj darovitosti i Neilovom mladenačkom šarmu, dvojac postiže velik uspjeh. Neil ubrzo postaje jedan od najtraženijih holivudskih scenarista. Obilazeći studije upoznaje Andreu, voditeljicu akvizicija i jedinu poklonicu Byrdienog rada, te se zaljubljuje u nju. Byrdie i Neil imaju grižnju savjesti što lažu Andrei, no preduboko su se uvalili da bi se sad povukli. Stvari se dodatno zakompliciraju kad Byrdiena obitelj, koja ne zna za njihovu podvalu, zaključi da Byrdie ima problema s alkoholom i organizira intervenciju. Unatoč njezinu žestokom protivljenju, Byrdie pošalju na odvikavanje pa ne može Neilu dostaviti scenarij. Neil pokuša sam pisati, no ubrzo shvaća da je pisanje scenarija daleko teže od hodanja po sastancima. Ima li 50-godišnjakinja šanse uspjeti u nemilosrdnom svijetu Hollywooda? I hoće li istina uništiti vezu njezina nećaka? Uloge: Kirstie Alley, Eric Christian Olsen, Stacy Grant, Peter Cockett, Britt Irven, Tobias Mehler Režija: Graeme Clifford Scenarij: George Beckerman Godina proizvodnje: 2007. Urednik: Dean Šoša R.: Graeme Clifford Ul.: Kirstie Alley (Byrdie Langdon), Eric Christian Olsen (Jason Langdon), Stacy Grant (Andrea Davis), Peter Cockett (Ray McDeere), Britt Irvin (Stacy Herskowitz)... / Write and Wrong - (komedija, SAD, 2007) TV film. programme.title: Zaboravljena bitka Nuštar 91. / Zaboravljena bitka Nuštar 91.
programme.desc: Zaboravljena bitka Nuštar 91. - (E01, dok. film, Hrvatska, 2018) U jesen 1991. godine Hrvatska bije bitku za opstanak. Na samom početku mjeseca studenoga slavonsko selo Nuštar našlo se u gotovo bezizlaznoj situaciji kao jedino neosvojeno uporište između grada na Dunavu i grada na Bosutu. I dok se sve više steže obruč oko Vukovara, a neprijatelj, zauzimajući selo za selom, sve se više približava Vinkovcima te je kolona prognanika sve duža, neizvjesno je koliko dugo će malobrojni i slabo naoružani branitelji moći odolijevati agresoru. Nuštar tih dana proživljava svoje najdramatičnije trenutke u povijesti, a ovo je priča o trodnevnoj zaboravljenoj bici, o očaju i nadi, o čudesnom junaštvu i pobjedi srca nad oklopom. Nuštar nije imao izbora, poraz bi pisao drugačiju povijest. Animacija: Mato Granić R.: Darko Bušnja... / Zaboravljena bitka Nuštar 91. - (E01, dok. film, Hrvatska, 2018) U jesen 1991. godine Hrvatska bije bitku za opstanak. programme.title: Zovite babicu / Zovite babicu
programme.desc: Call the Midwife - (S01, E03, dramska serija, Engleska, 2012) Jenny se ovoga puta ne susreće s početkom, već s krajem života. Frank, brat čistačice Peggy iz Nonnatus Housea, obolio je od raka, a sestre se brinu o njemu. Jenny tako bolje upoznaje njihovu tešku prošlost i odnos koji je oblikovalo djetinjstvo provedeno u ubožnici. Paralelno, ostale stanovnice kuće pomažu Fredu u njegovoj (pomalo nesvakidašnjoj) poslovnoj ideji - uzgoju prasice Evie. No plan o zaradi od slanine mijenja se kad Evie ostane skotna. Uz to policija pronalazi sestru Monicu Joan kako luta po dokovima i vraća je u Nonnatus House. Nakon oporavka od upale pluća, vraća se svojim obavezama - sve dok je ne optuže za krađu... programme.title: Priče s končom iz borše Stanka Ferića / Priče s končom iz borše Stanka Ferića
programme.desc: Priče s končom iz borše Stanka Ferića - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2021) Opojnog i slatkog vinskog nektara - desertne maraštine koja se tijekom nekoliko stoljeća, sve do sredine XX. proizvodila u šibenskom kraju, danas se još malo tko sjeća. Ali nekoć je to vino ondje imala gotovo svaka kuća, ne samo plemićka i građanska već i težačka. Pilo ga se u malim količinama, za blagdane, kao delikatesu, ali i stavljalo u pojedina, također delikatesna jela, poput skradinske torte, ili mirisnih božićnih kobasica, luganiga. Šibenske obitelji Tambača i Škarica obogatile su se na njegovoj proizvodnji tijekom XIX. i prve polovine XX. st., primajući za njega na međunarodnim izložbama i brojna vinska odličja. Međutim, nakon II. svjetskog rata delikatna i relativno složena proizvodnja desertne maraštine stagnirala je, a na kraju i sasvim prestala - sve do 2019., kad je, u suradnji HRT-a i Vinarije Sladić iz Plastova, sela iznad Skradina, a na poticaj našeg pripovjedača s končom, Stanka Ferića, ponovno pokrenuta... Istraživač i narator: Stanko Ferić Izvođač originalne glazbe: Alan Bjelinski R.: Ivo Kuzmanić Ul.: Stanko Ferić (Narator)... / Priče s končom iz borše Stanka Ferića - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2021) Opojnog i slatkog vinskog nektara - desertne maraštine koja se tijekom nekoliko stoljeća, sve do sredine XX. proizvodila u šibenskom kraju, danas se još malo tko sjeća. programme.title: Oblak u službi zakona / Oblak u službi zakona
programme.desc: Oblak u službi zakona - (S03, E05, zab. serija, Hrvatska, 2025) Nakon uspješnice Odmori se, zaslužio si, scenaristi Snježana i Goran Tribuson pripremili su nam novu poslasticu, obiteljsku humorističnu seriju - Oblak u službi zakona. Spoj je to obiteljske serije s laganim krimi zapletom, jer Nikola (Ozren Grabarić), glava obitelji Oblak, policijski je narednik. Idealist je i poštenjačina koji vjeruje u neke ljudske vrijednosti te ih nerijetko prepoznaje i tamo gdje ih nema. Za razliku od Nikole, drugi članovi obitelji Oblak daleko su realističniji i skloniji postupcima koji su, iako benigni, na rubu zakonitosti. Nikolina žena Jagoda (Dijana Vidušin) ne može naći posao, a kako bi pridonijela ionako malom kućnom budžetu, često pribjegava radu na crno. Kreativna, znatiželjna, pomalo samozatajna, posvetila se Nikoli i djeci te je potpuna suprotnost susjedi, mesarici Greti (Ksenija Marinković). Dvojica njihovih sinova, Bruno (Toma Medvešek) i Ratko (Borna Fadljević), adolescenti, izvor su mnogih problema. Mlađi, Ratko, intelektualno je nadmoćan svima u kući dok se za starijeg Brunu, koji nikako da završi školu, to ne bi moglo reći. Većinu vremena Bruno provodi u lokalnoj birtiji kod Suvog (Zoran Čubrilo) i Ludviga (Goran Navojec) koji se, iako stariji, ne razlikuju previše od njega. Različiti karakteri i sklonosti članova obitelji Oblak izvor su humornih situacija i zapleta, a u svakoj epizodi Nikola rješava i jedan kriminalistički slučaj: provalu u kiosk, krađu automobila, provalu u kvartovski dječji vrtić, sitne prevare... No iako u poslu uspješan, inteligentniji i bolji policajac od svog partnera Požgaja (Igor Mešin) koji ima široku lepezu interesa pa se rijetko stigne posvetiti policijskim zadaćama, kao i od šefa Bože (Željko Koenigsknecht), nikako da napreduje u policijskoj hijerarhiji... R.: Dražen Žarković Ul.: Borna Fadljević, Branka Cvitković (Blanka), Dominik Čičak (Mladji policajac), Goran Grgić (Pohajda), Goran Navojec... / Oblak u službi zakona - (S03, E05, zab. serija, Hrvatska, 2025) Nakon uspješnice Odmori se, zaslužio si, scenaristi Snježana i Goran Tribuson pripremili su nam novu poslasticu, obiteljsku humorističnu seriju - Oblak u službi zakona. programme.title: Volim Hrvatsku / Volim Hrvatsku
programme.desc: Volim Hrvatsku - (S12, E05, show program, Hrvatska, 2025) Nedjeljna popodneva ponovno uveseljava ekipa šoua Volim Hrvatsku. Kapetani su Dušan Bućan i Goran Navojec. U petoj emisiji u Dušanovom timu nastupaju: Antonela Đinđić, Romina Tonković i Goran Grgić, dok će u Goranovom timu biti Laura Sučec, Dino Antonić i Jelena Perčin. programme.title: Superpotjera / Superpotjera
programme.desc: Superpotjera - (zabavni program, Hrvatska) U Superpotjeri je prvi put petero lovaca okupljeno u supertim. Samouvjereni do neba, svih petero rade kao jedan. Spremni su upustiti se u bitku sa svima koji dolaze. Stvorili su jedan od najmoćnijih kvizaških timova na planetu pa se postavlja pitanje: Tko ima sve što je potrebno da bi pobijedio lovce? Superpotjera (u izvorniku: Beat the Chasers) licencni je natjecateljski televizijski format kviza znanja u kojem natjecatelj najprije osigurava potencijalni novčani iznos u samostalnoj igri odgovaranja na pitanja s višestrukim izborom. Pod uvjetom da tijekom spomenute samostalne igre uspije osigurati određeni novčani iznos, nastavlja s natjecanjem u kojem ima priliku osvojiti novčanu nagradu igrajući protiv dva, tri, četiri ili svih pet lovaca. Lovci su: Sven Marcelić, Morana Zibar, Krešimir Sučević Međeral, Mladen Vukorepa i Dean Kotiga. R.: Danko Volarić... / Superpotjera - (zabavni program, Hrvatska) U Superpotjeri je prvi put petero lovaca okupljeno u supertim. Samouvjereni do neba, svih petero rade kao jedan. programme.title: Appaloosa na kraju puta / Appaloosa na kraju puta
programme.desc: Appaloosa - (vestern, SAD, 2008) Viggo Mortensen i Ed Harris glume unajmljene čuvare zakona u lovu na odbjeglog ubojicu, a oskarovka Renee Zellweger glumi lijepu i opasnu udovicu s prikrivenim namjerama. Njihovi će se putovi ukrižiti u bezakonjem rastrganom gradiću Appaloosi na Divljem zapadu. Virgil Cole (Harris) i Everett Hitch (Mortensen) stižu u Appaloosu, malen, prašnjav grad koji zlostavlja rančer odmetnik bez imalo poštovanja prema zakonu. Redovito otima robu iz dućana, konje i žene, a ubio je i gradskog šerifa i njegove zamjenike. Cole i Hitch, putujući čuvari reda i mira, znaju kako se riješiti oportunističkih kradljivaca, no ovaj put nailaze na neuobičajeno tvrdokornog protivnika koji ne samo da se vješto poigrava sa zakonom, već i s njihovim osjećajima.
